concepts.quote: break stops the loop completely at 5
concepts.why: It applies break correctly to this code: at i == 5 the whole loop ends. It is not L3 because the answer never says that both statements skip the rest of the body.

concepts.quote: continue jumps to the next i for the even numbers
concepts.why: It applies continue correctly to this code's values: the even i are skipped and the loop goes on to the next i. The contrast with break is two separate rules applied side by side, not a stated relation.
The answer says nothing about the labeled loop.
